Forecast run: Thu, Nov 5, 12:45 PM (the page refreshes this a few times a day).
Each hour: time, direction and speed (knots, g = gust), odds of 12kt or more, regime, waves, tide height in ft with r rising or f falling. OUTFLOW NOT RIDDEN = Squamish outflow, never recommend. OFF DIR = direction does not work at that spot.
Riding light (first light to last light, Vancouver): Thu, Nov 5 7:33am to 6:19pm; Fri, Nov 6 7:34am to 6:17pm; Sat, Nov 7 7:36am to 6:16pm. Hours outside that are dark and not listed; never suggest riding then.

Guillermo's own take for Thu, Nov 5 (his read, quote it as his, not yours): Inflow day in Howe Sound, but it hasn't started yet. Pam Rocks read SSE 2 at 5am, and the Squamish terminal sensor had WSW 11 gusting 14 at 5:30am. Environment Canada still has a strong wind warning for southerly inflow, but the 4am update backed off to 15 to 25 (it was 20 to 30 last night). The page has Porteau at only 5 to 9, with Pam Rocks peaking around 13 at 3pm. Pemberton is about 1 hPa below Vancouver, not the 2 to 3 that gave us the big inflow on Oct 27.

Porteau is a maybe for the afternoon, noon to 4pm. A good inflow needs about 14 from the south at Pam Rocks, so if it reads 14+ by noon, go. The tide floods from 7.8ft at 9:09am to 14.8ft at 3:29pm, which can flatten the swell. Squamish is the same call: the page has 9 to 11 from 1pm to 4pm, so watch the terminal sensor for 15+.

The Strait is light this morning, building to SE 15 to 20 near noon. Advanced riders: Tsawwassen south side, 11 to 12 from 11am.

Friday is the day: gale warning, SE 25 to 35 in the Strait Friday morning.

EC marine forecast, Howe Sound (issued 10:30 AM PCT 05 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Today Tonight and Friday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 15 to 25 knots today tonight and Friday.

EC marine forecast, Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo) (issued 10:30 AM PCT 05 November 2026), WARNING IN EFFECT: Today Tonight and Friday. Gale warning in effect. Wind southeast 5 to 15 knots increasing to southeast 15 to 20 early this afternoon and to southeast 20 to 25 near midnight. Wind increasing to southeast 30 to 35 early Friday morning then diminishing to southeast 20 to 30 Friday afternoon. Wind diminishing to southeast 10 to 20 Friday evening.

Track record, last 30 days: Porteau Cove (scored at Pam Rocks): typical miss 3.66kt, caught 67% of windy hours, 9% false alarms; Steveston - Garry Point Park (scored at Sand Heads): typical miss 2.54kt, caught 76% of windy hours, 18% false alarms; Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal Causeway (scored at Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal): typical miss 2.64kt, caught 57% of windy hours, 18% false alarms; Erwin Park (scored at Point Atkinson): typical miss 2.89kt, caught 35% of windy hours, 34% false alarms. Other spots are not measured yet.
